prompt_en: Photorealistic vertical eye-level medium-close photograph inside a warm maid cafe. One explicitly adult original human nekomimi tsundere maid stands behind a wooden counter in a covered navy frilled apron. She is a pretty and cute adult woman in her late twenties with a polished bishoujo-inspired character-design read: harmonious refined adult facial features, clear lively almond-shaped eyes at realistic adult scale, a softly expressive mouth, glossy well-kept dark hair, and cohesive maid styling. Her appealing face is the first-read focus, not the costume or body. Her baseline is brisk, guarded service. An adult customer's lightly bandaged hand reaches from the lower foreground for a steaming standard takeaway cup. Freeze mid-sleeving before the protective handoff is complete: her right hand holds the cup just beyond the customer's fingertips while her left hand slides a normal six-centimeter-tall corrugated kraft coffee sleeve only halfway up it, leaving a clear open gap and much of the white cup visible. Her mouth forms a tiny huff and her face turns away, yet the compact ear nearest the customer pivots sideways toward the reaching hand while the far ear stays upright and forward; her bright eyes steal one reluctant glance back. The half-seated sleeve already protects the cup while the transfer remains unfinished. Her adult human face, forearms, five-fingered hands, short nails, frilled apron, and service role remain clear. Only two small living cat ears emerge organically through the hairline; no tail. Three-quarter frontal framing keeps both unequal ear angles, her face, both working hands, the customer hand, cup, and half-seated sleeve in one tight focal plane, with the cup confined to the lower third. Warm practical light gives her eyes clean catchlights and preserves natural skin, glossy hair, fabric texture, cup steam, contact shadows, and shallow falloff. Nonsexual everyday comedy, observed rather than posed.
